games.name: Wall Hop Slap Meter
games.desc:
Slap your opponent across the meter and watch where they land! The number on the meter is the wallhop stage they have to beat — make it to the end before your hearts run out.

✅ HOW TO WALL HOP
1. Walk up to the wall until your feet are at the line at the bottom.
2. Turn your character 90 degrees to the left or to the right.
3. Keep walking into the wall, and flick your camera in the same direction you turned your character.
4. Your character will pop up the wall.
IMPORTANT: Set your FPS to 60. Wall hopping is way easier 

🖥️ FEATURES
- 11 wallhop stages plus the co-op Troll Stage
- Lobby with practice time trials
- Trophy leaderboard
- Gamepasses: Trail, Double Jump, Extra Life
- mobile support
